comment: What Undertow (user/undertow/) is built from, pinned by SHA-256 (third_party/README.md). tools/fetch-webdeps.py fetches and checks mbedtls; the CA bundle is committed and only checked (tools/fetch-webdeps.py --check).

mbedtls.license: Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later (the archive's LICENSE, extracted with the sources)
mbedtls.released: 2026-07-07, the 3.6 long-term support branch (supported until at least March 2027)
mbedtls.checksum_checked: 2026-10-11: the release notes' SHA-256, the release asset mbedtls-3.6.7-sha256sum.txt and GitHub's asset digest all give this value, as does the archive itself

advisories_checked.newest_release: 3.6.7 is the newest 3.6 release (GitHub releases, 2026-10-11); 4.2.0 and 4.1.1 came out the same day
advisories_checked.result: No advisory was published after 3.6.7: the newest (July 2026) came with it. Every advisory of 2026 says 3.6.7 is not affected, the July ones fixed in 3.6.7 and the March ones in 3.6.6, except CVE-2025-66442 (below), which names no fixed version.

not_applicable.CVE-2026-54434: Everest's X25519, only in 4.1.0 (3.6.7 is not affected, and MBEDTLS_ECDH_VARIANT_EVEREST_ENABLED is off here)
not_applicable.CVE-2025-66442: compiler-induced constant-time violations: affects all versions, known only for Clang with select-optimize; SurfOS builds with GCC, and the affected operations (RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption, CBC padding) are not used by this client

ca_bundle.source: curl's extraction of Mozilla's CA certificate store (https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html), updated by Mozilla on 2026-09-25
ca_bundle.retrieved: 2026-10-10, checked again 2026-10-11 against https://curl.se/ca/cacert-2026-09-25.pem.sha256 and a fresh download
